title: Scattered Conditional Compilation Flags
pattern: Scattering conditional compilation directives (like `#[cfg(...)]`) for target hardware/environments inside multiple functional methods.
why_bad: Adding support for a new hardware variant requires hunting down and altering thousands of compile-time branch flags, which is highly error-prone.
detection: The exact same conditional compilation flag (e.g., `#[cfg(feature = "...") ]`) appearing repeatedly inside functional bodies rather than block modules.
counterexample: High-level module definitions gating platform-specific drivers (e.g., `#[cfg(target_os = "windows")] mod win;`).
